en.shortDescription: Static analysis and SAST via the Semgrep MCP server
en.longDescription:
Semgrep MCP exposes static analysis tools over HTTP for IDE and agent integrations.

Optional SEMGREP_APP_TOKEN unlocks Semgrep Platform features via SERVICE_PASSWORD_SEMGREP. The API listens on port 8000 at /mcp.

de.shortDescription: Statische Analyse und SAST über den Semgrep-MCP-Server

fr.shortDescription: Analyse statique et SAST via le serveur MCP Semgrep

pt.shortDescription: Análise estática e SAST via servidor MCP do Semgrep
